title: About Display ads and the Google Display Network

facts.fact: Google states that Display campaigns can reach people worldwide across 35 million websites and apps, plus Google-owned properties (YouTube and Gmail).
facts.quote: Display campaigns can reach people worldwide across 35 million websites and apps, and on Google-owned properties (YouTube and Gmail).

facts.fact: Google states that Optimized targeting is the default targeting method for Display campaigns, and advertisers may select a different targeting method.
facts.quote: Optimized targeting is set as the default targeting method for your Display campaigns.

facts.fact: Google states that Display ads are responsive by default, except when advertisers use uploaded Display ads.
Google states that advertisers can pay for conversions instead of clicks on Display campaigns that use Target CPA bidding.
facts.quote: You can pay for conversions, instead of clicks on Display campaigns that use Target CPA bidding.

facts.fact: Google states that existing Smart Display campaigns migrated to the unified Display campaign structure without any action needed from advertisers.
facts.quote: Any existing Smart Display campaigns in your account will have migrated to this unified Display campaign structure without any action needed on your part.

facts.fact: Google states that the migration of Smart Display campaigns to the unified Display campaign structure should not cause fluctuations in campaign performance.
facts.quote: This migration shouldn't cause any fluctuations in your campaign's performance.

facts.fact: Google claims that Display campaigns optimize within days.
